period: 2024-25: relief counts as at 31 December 2023 and 2024, relief value forecasts for 2024-25 and 2025-26, and the 2024-25 NNDR3 outturn
method: Values were read from the downloaded files on the access date by tools/extract_uk_firm_empty_property_tables.py, from the England row of each supplementary sheet (columns found by MHCLG variable name) and the '2024 to 2025' column of NNDR3 Tables 1, 1a and 2; none was filled from memory.

coverage: Counts are hereditaments in receipt of mandatory empty premises relief at the snapshot date, not all empty hereditaments: an empty property past its 3-month (6 for industrial) exemption pays full rates and is not counted. The six sub-categories (industrial above the exemption threshold, listed building, community amateur sports club, charity, not in the previous four, non-industrial above the exemption threshold) partition the total; the relief value sub-categories do not quite sum to the relief total as published. No source gives the rateable value of empty property, empty shares by property type, or empty durations.
caveats: NNDR1 2024-25 supplementary Note 7: the split of empty property relief by category was first published in 2024-25 and was validated against earlier unvalidated data; use with caution.
NNDR1 2025-26 Table 4 Note 25: for 2024 the empty premises hereditament count is under investigation for 2 local authorities; data are as provided by the authorities.

The NNDR1 2025-26 relief labels read 'to be granted in 2024-25' as published; the forecast year is taken from the sheet title, and the total equals Table 2's 2025-26 empty premises forecast (£1,084.979229 million).
NNDR1 2024-25 supplementary Note 3: Three Rivers and Watford supplied no supplementary figures for 31 December 2023.
